summary: Computes a slot-based storage index as 560 * a1 + 140 (with a register-sourced third term), converts argument a2 to a value via BufferSizeLookup, and stores that value at the computed location through FloatStoreWithConversion, returning the store result. Called from NetCommPlayerSlotSync, suggesting a per-player-slot control value being synced from the network layer.

local_names.v2: value returned by BufferSizeLookup(a2); the operand stored by FloatStoreWithConversion
local_names.v3: ecx-register value read uninitialised by the decompiler; unresolved third term of the index expression

operations.description: v2 = BufferSizeLookup(a2) converts/looks up argument a2 into the value that will be stored.
Index expression 560 * a1 + v3 + 140: a 140-byte base within a 560-byte-stride per-slot structure selected by a1.
FloatStoreWithConversion(index, v2) stores value v2 at the computed location, applying its float/type conversion.
Invoked from NetCommPlayerSlotSync (0x0045FC50), implying the stored value participates in per-slot network synchronisation.

unresolved: v3 (ecx) is read uninitialised in the decompiled source; it is likely a hidden __fastcall register parameter or this-pointer artifact of the original calling convention, and its value is undefined from this packet alone.
The 560-byte stride per a1 slot and the +140 base are sourced from the packet's arithmetic but the array/object they address is not identified.
Whether the stored operand is a float, integer bits, or converted between types depends on FloatStoreWithConversion's contract, which is not in this packet.
The per-player-slot reading is inferred from the ABI lead name (Player_Control_Set) and the NetCommPlayerSlotSync caller; it is not confirmed.
